summary: Join our Islamic Banking and Finance Principles Training Course. Learn key concepts and practices to excel in ethical finance and banking solutions.
lede: Islamic banking and finance principles guide professionals in structuring financial products around prohibitions on interest, uncertainty and gambling. For product developers, compliance officers and investment professionals, the course builds skills in distinguishing financing contracts, preparing Murabaha term sheets, assessing portfolios for Shari’ah compliance and structuring Sukuk, while also covering profit-sharing and Takaful models.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals operating within or intersecting with the Islamic financial ecosystem who require a rigorous understanding of Shari’ah-compliant operations.
modules: Islamic Finance Foundations and Ethical Frameworks
Islamic Capital Markets and Sukuk Structuring
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of general banking and finance concepts. No prior knowledge of Shari’ah law is required, though familiarity with financial statements and basic contract law is recommended. No coding or programming is required for this course.
